content.name: Wild Companion
entries: You can summon a nature spirit that assumes an animal form to aid you. As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast the {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52} spell without Material components.
When you cast the spell in this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
